program.name: Biotechnology
program.summary: Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology, 4 years (8 semesters and 1 special semester), full time.

costs.note: International: RM 70,600 for the programme (UM's fee structure is based on the minimum period of study, 4 years), shown as RM 17,650 a year. Not inclusive of 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST).

admissions.threshold: Biotechnology (international): a recognised GCE A-Level qualification with at least grade B in Biology and at least 60%/grade B- in one of Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
Biotechnology (international): a minimum of 30 points, with at least Grade 5 (HL) / 6 (SL) in Biology and in one of Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
